This case also gives other root. \( -1 - \sqrt{3} \)

So, there are two roots.

data.question_title: A boggy of uniformly moving train is suddenly detached from train and stops after covering some distance. The distance covered by the boggy and distance covered by the train in the same time has relation
data.explanation_txt:
Let 'a' be the retardation of boggy then distance covered by it be S. If u is the initial velocity of boggy after detaching from train (i.e. uniform speed of train).

\(v ^ { 2 } = u ^ { 2 } + 2 a s \Rightarrow 0 = u ^ { 2 } - 2 a s \Rightarrow s _ { b } = \cfrac { u ^ { 2 } } { 2 a }\)

Time taken by boggy to stop,

\(v = u + a t \Rightarrow 0 = u - a t \Rightarrow t = \cfrac { u } { a }\)

In this time t distance travelled by train \(= s _ { t } = u t = \cfrac { u ^ { 2 } } { a }\)

Hence, ratio is given as \(\cfrac { s _ { b } } { s _ { t } } = \cfrac { 1 } { 2 }\)

data.explanation_txt:
The arrangement is equivalent to three capacitors in parallel.

\(C_{2}=\cfrac{K \varepsilon_{0} \cfrac{A}{2}}{d}=4 \times \cfrac{10}{2}=20 \mu \mathrm{F}\)

\(C_{3}=\cfrac{\varepsilon_0 \cfrac{A}{4}}{d}=\cfrac{10}{4}=2.5 \mu \mathrm{F}\)

\(\therefore \, C_p = C_1 + C_2 + C_3 \)

\(\quad C_{p}=2.5+20+2.5=25 \mu \mathrm{F}\)
